fullDescription: Corporate-calm mega-menu navbar: a sticky deep-navy bar (#0b1f3a) with an amber accent (#f0b429), an announcement strip above and a wide white drop-down mega-menu below: three labeled link columns (icon + title + one-liner) plus a navy gradient 'Featured' card with a prompt-to-UI micro-interaction. Inter, rounded-lg controls, one high-contrast amber CTA, and a clean responsive collapse to a navy accordion drawer. Light page, dark header.

structured.summary: A sticky, corporate-calm mega-menu navbar for products with depth. A deep-navy bar (#0b1f3a) carries a wordmark on the left, a center nav whose active 'Products' item opens a wide white drop-down mega-menu, and one high-contrast amber CTA on the right; an amber-tagged announcement strip sits above the bar. The open mega-menu is a 12-col grid: 8 cols of three labeled link columns (icon tile + title + one-line description) and a 4-col navy-gradient 'Featured' card with a product-specific prompt-to-UI micro-interaction, closed by a light footer strip. Inter type, amber-on-navy contrast, rounded-lg controls, and a clean reflow to a full navy accordion drawer on tablet/mobile.

style.description: Trustworthy enterprise-SaaS look: deep navy chrome, crisp white menu surface, and a single warm amber accent doing all the pointing. Inter throughout with slightly tight tracking on the wordmark/headings. Soft, layered shadows give the mega-menu real depth; a subtle dotted grain and a radial navy gradient add texture to the dark surfaces. Corporate calm + amber punch: restrained color, generous spacing, one loud CTA.
style.prompt: Use a polished enterprise-SaaS visual language. Background of the page is white (#ffffff); the navbar chrome is deep navy. Typeface: Inter (weights 400/500/600/700/800/900), antialiased. Apply slightly tight letter-spacing (-0.02em) on the wordmark, hero and section headings (a .tracking-tightish utility). COLOR SYSTEM is navy + amber + cool slates: navy DEFAULT #0b1f3a (bar + dark sections), navy-800 #0e2748 (announcement strip, deeper CTA band), navy-700 #13335e and navy-600 #1b4377 (gradient stops + glow). The single accent is AMBER #f0b429 (logo tile, CTA fill, active chevron, eyebrow labels, 'Featured' tag), amber-600 #d99a14 (CTA hover), amber-700 #8a5a00 (link hover on light), amber-100 #fdf3d6 (the one tinted feature card). On the white menu surface use cool slates: slate-panel #f4f6fa (hover rows, footer strip, light section bg), slate-line #e3e8f0 (hairline borders), slate-ink #2a3a52 (logo-strip ink), slate-soft #51607a (muted body + eyebrows). On dark surfaces, layer text as white at opacity (white/85 nav links, white/70 body, white/60 descriptions, white/40 meta) and borders as white/10 to white/15. SHADOWS define the menu depth: mega = '0 32px 80px -24px rgba(11,31,58,0.45), 0 8px 24px -12px rgba(11,31,58,0.25)' on the dropdown panel, card = '0 1px 2px rgba(11,31,58,0.06), 0 12px 28px -16px rgba(11,31,58,0.22)' on feature cards; the amber CTA gets a colored glow '0 6px 18px -6px rgba(240,180,41,0.6)'. TEXTURE: a .grain dotted radial pattern (radial-gradient(circle at 1px 1px, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 1px, transparent 0); 22px tile) over dark surfaces, and a .menu-grad radial gradient (radial-gradient(120% 120% at 0% 0%, #13335e 0%, #0b1f3a 60%)) on the Featured card. Controls are rounded-lg (8px) for nav items/buttons and rounded-xl/2xl (12-16px) for cards/menu. Icons via Iconify Lucide (lucide:component, chevron-down, arrow-right, wand-sparkles, layout-dashboard, blocks, terminal, git-branch, share-2, library, shapes, palette, sparkles, arrow-up-right) sized 14-22px. Keep exactly ONE loud action (the amber 'Start free' button); everything else is quiet.

layout_and_structure.description: A sticky header (sticky top-0 z-50) stacking two strips: a thin navy-800 announcement strip and the main navy bar (h-68px, bg-navy/95 + backdrop-blur, hairline bottom border). The bar is left wordmark / center nav / right CTA. The active center item ('Products') opens the mega-menu, which renders absolutely below the bar inside the same max-w-[1200px] container: a rounded-2xl white panel with the 'mega' shadow, laid out as a 12-col grid -> 8 cols hold three labeled link columns, 4 cols hold a navy-gradient Featured card, with a light slate footer strip across the bottom. Below lg the whole menu collapses into a full-width navy accordion drawer (the 'Products' section expanded inline as <details>, the rest as chevron rows) plus stacked mobile CTAs. Everything aligns to a centered mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 container.

prompts.partPt: Sticky Menu do Topo shell + announcement strip
prompts.prompt: Wrap everything in a header that is sticky top-0 z-50. First child: a thin announcement strip, bg-navy-800 (#0e2748), text white/85 at 12.5px, an h-9 centered row inside mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6 holding a small amber pill ('New', uppercase, bg-amber/15 text-amber, rounded-full), one line of copy ('Component Studio 2.0 is live...'), and an amber 'Read more ->' link (lucide:arrow-right). Hide the long copy below sm.

prompts.part: Main navy bar (left wordmark / center nav / right CTA)
prompts.partPt: Main navy bar (left wordmark / center nav / right Chamada Final para Ação)
prompts.prompt: Below the strip, a <nav> with bg-navy/95 (#0b1f3a), backdrop-blur-md, a 1px bottom border-white/10, text white. Inner mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6, an h-[68px] flex row, items-center, justify-between, gap-6. LEFT: wordmark = an 8x8 amber (#f0b429) rounded-[9px] tile with a navy lucide:component icon and an amber drop-shadow, next to 'Quanta' at 18px font-extrabold tracking-tightish with an amber period. CENTER (hidden below lg): a flex row gap-1 of nav items at 14px font-medium text-white/85: the first ('Products') is the ACTIVE/open trigger styled as a button with bg-white/10, text-white and an amber chevron rotated 180deg; the rest ('Solutions','Library','Pricing','Docs') are rounded-lg px-3.5 py-2 links that hover to bg-white/10. RIGHT: a 'Log in' ghost link (hidden below md), then the primary CTA = an amber pill 'Start free' (bg-amber, text-navy, font-bold, rounded-lg, px-4 py-2.5, lucide:arrow-right) with the amber glow shadow, then a lg:hidden 40px square menu toggle (amber on bg-amber/15, border-amber/40).

Render the mega-menu absolutely (absolute inset-x-0 top-full) inside the same mx-auto max-w-[1200px] px-6. Add a mt-2 rounded-2xl panel, bg-white text-navy, ring-1 ring-navy/10, with the 'mega' box-shadow. Inside it a grid grid-cols-12. Optionally place a fixed inset-0 navy/45 backdrop-blur scrim behind it (top offset = header height, -z-1) to convey the open-overlay depth.

prompts.part: Three labeled link columns (8 of 12 cols)
prompts.partPt: Three labeled link columns (8 of 12 cols)
prompts.prompt: First grid child is col-span-8, p-7, an inner grid-cols-3 gap-x-7. Each column starts with an 11px font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] slate-soft (#51607a) eyebrow ('Generate' / 'Workflow' / 'Library'), then a list of link rows. Each row: a rounded-xl p-2.5 anchor that hovers to bg-slate-panel (#f4f6fa), containing a 9x9 rounded-lg icon tile (first column = solid bg-navy with amber icon; other columns = bg-slate-panel with navy icon and ring-1 ring-slate-line) + a two-line label: a 14px font-semibold title and a 12.5px slate-soft description (e.g. 'Prompt to UI / Turn a sentence into a real screen.'). Use Lucide icons: wand-sparkles, layout-dashboard, blocks; terminal, git-branch, share-2; library, shapes, palette.

prompts.part: Featured card (4 of 12 cols) with prompt-to-UI micro-interaction
prompts.partPt: Featured card (4 of 12 cols) with prompt-to-UI micro-interaction
prompts.prompt: Second grid child is col-span-4, p-4, holding a full-height rounded-xl card with the .menu-grad navy radial gradient, white text, p-6, and a .grain overlay. Top: an amber 'Featured' pill (uppercase), a 19px font-extrabold heading ('Ship a full dashboard in one prompt') and a 13px white/70 subhead. Then a PRODUCT-SPECIFIC micro-interaction (NOT browser chrome): a white/4 ring-1 ring-white/10 box containing a faux prompt input row (bg-navy-800/80, an amber wand icon, the text 'Sales dashboard, dark, 3 stat cards', and a blinking amber caret), a 'generates' divider with amber hairlines, then a tiny generated-UI mock = a row of 3 stat tiles (one with an amber value bar) over a 6-bar mini chart (one amber bar) built from white/7 tiles. Footer: an amber 'Watch the 90s demo ->' link whose arrow nudges on hover.

Close the panel with a flex justify-between row, border-t border-slate-line, bg-slate-panel, px-7 py-3.5, 13px. Left: a slate-soft 'Not sure where to start?' line with a navy lucide:sparkles and a navy underlined 'Take the 2-min tour' link. Right: a navy 'Compare all plans' link with lucide:arrow-up-right. Both hover toward amber-700 (#8a5a00).

Below lg, replace the dropdown with a full-width lg:hidden drawer: border-t border-white/10, bg-navy/98, backdrop-blur, max-h-[calc(100vh-108px)] overflow-y-auto. Render nav as stacked rows divided by border-white/10: 'Products' is an open <details> (summary with an amber chevron that flips when open) revealing the SAME groups inline (the Generate list as full rows, Workflow + Library as a 2-col chip grid, plus a compact version of the Featured card); the other items ('Solutions','Library','Pricing','Docs') are simple rows with a white/40 lucide:chevron-right. Below the nav: two stacked full-width CTAs (amber 'Start free' filled, then a white/5 bordered 'Log in'), and a centered amber 'Take the 2-min tour' link. No horizontal overflow at 390px.

special_ui_components.prompt: Sticky two-tier header: a thin navy-800 announcement strip with an amber 'New' pill above the main navy/95 backdrop-blur bar
Active-state center nav item ('Products') styled as an open trigger (bg-white/10 + amber chevron rotated 180deg) that owns the mega-menu
Wide white drop-down mega-menu on a rounded-2xl panel with a deep layered 'mega' shadow and ring, rendered in the same max-w-[1200px] container
12-col mega-menu layout: 8 cols of three labeled link columns (icon tile + title + one-line description) + a 4-col navy-gradient Featured card

Product-specific 'prompt -> generated UI' micro-interaction inside the Featured card (faux prompt input with blinking amber caret + a tiny stat-cards/bar-chart mock), instead of generic browser chrome
Amber-on-navy primary CTA with a colored glow shadow, kept as the single loud action against an otherwise quiet bar
Light slate footer strip closing the menu ('Take the 2-min tour' + 'Compare all plans')
Responsive collapse to a full-width navy accordion drawer (Products expanded inline as <details>, other items as chevron rows) with stacked mobile CTAs

structured.special_notes: Keep the palette strictly navy (#0b1f3a / #0e2748 / #13335e / #1b4377) + amber (#f0b429, hover #d99a14) + cool slates (#f4f6fa / #e3e8f0 / #2a3a52 / #51607a); express dark-surface hierarchy through white opacity (white/85 nav, white/70 body, white/60 descriptions) rather than extra hues. The mega-menu must render as a wide WHITE panel with the layered 'mega' shadow inside the centered max-w-[1200px] container, NOT a narrow dropdown. Preserve the three-labeled-column + Featured-card split (8/4 of a 12-col grid) and keep the Featured card's micro-interaction PRODUCT-SPECIFIC (a prompt input that 'generates' a mini dashboard) rather than a stock browser/URL-bar mock. Keep exactly ONE loud amber CTA ('Start free') with its glow; the active 'Products' item must read as open (bg-white/10 + flipped amber chevron). On reflow below lg, the menu becomes a navy accordion drawer with the Products section expanded inline, and must not overflow at 390px. Inter throughout with the tracking-tightish (-0.02em) treatment on the wordmark/headings. The hero, logo strip, feature grid, CTA band and footer below the header are optional page context, not part of the navbar pattern itself.
